title: Orbital Debris
description: Every launch leaves something in orbit: spent stages, bolts, flecks of paint. At 10 km/s a fleck of paint chips a window and a bolt carries a grenade's energy. When there is enough of it, collisions break satellites into more debris, which breaks more: Kessler syndrome. Low orbits clean themselves slowly, as the thin air drags things down; a sweeper can speed it up. Unlocks the Debris Sweeper. (Debris can be turned off in the config.)

puzzle.goal: A fragment of mass m strikes at speed v. Write the energy E it carries.
puzzle.name: Impact energy
puzzle.ask: Find E in J for m = @{m} kg at v = 10000 m/s.
puzzle.method: Kinetic energy, ½mv²: at orbital speed even a gram is tens of kilojoules.
